gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Spaced out and retro, Vast Shadow draws every stroke at a single width. And Noto Sans Soyombo, big in the x-height and open in its curves, stays readable at modest sizes on screen.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Clean and unwavering, Vast Shadow cuts every letter to one width, while Noto Sans Tagalog fills the line with generous curves. Body text at a moderate size suits it best.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Constant-width lines, wire-like and unvarying, give Vast Shadow its look, while Noto Sans Tagbanwa sits below with open, clear-gapped curves. Its lowercase fills most of the height, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Vast Shadow gives each o a constant wall, a display face spaced generously. Noto Sans Tai Viet adds short ascenders and a tall x-height, and that mix of showy and sensible is the draw.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Every stroke at one thickness, like bent tubing, defines Vast Shadow. Noto Sans Tamil, its text looking magnified and its terminals stopping far from the stem, lets the heading be the loud one.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Loud and retro, Vast Shadow keeps one flat line weight through every glyph, while Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide. Short ascender stems make paragraphs feel friendly and easy going.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Vintage in spirit, Vast Shadow bends every letter like tubing of one gauge. And what stands out is how far apart they sit: loud tubing against Noto Sans Telugu, with its high midline and connected counters.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-orienta: Modern at heart, Vast Shadow holds its thickness steady around every curve. Orienta, with its breathing counters and little difference in case height, makes paragraphs read smoothly and without fuss.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-pathway-extreme: Wiry and showy, Vast Shadow draws every letter in one wire-like line. And it earns its keep big and brief, while Pathway Extreme handles the stubby-ascender, open-curved text beneath.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-pt-sans-caption: Tube-like and spaced out: Vast Shadow keeps its thickness steady through every bend. PT Sans Caption, with its big-bodied lowercase and open bowls, gives paragraphs a friendly, unhurried pace.
